reviews.title: Best Bridge Learning App
reviews.text: I love the Audrey Grant bridge app it has a new column every day, the quizzes are great to measure knowledge, there are levels from beginner to advanced and 2/1 hands.  If you love bridge and want to sharpen your skills and test your own knowledge get the Audrey Grant Better Bridge today!

reviews.title: Better than newspaper columns by far
reviews.text: Being able to play and replay the hand, combined with columns that clearly explain what to look for and how to strategize, make this the most useful daily column I've seen. The Sunday bidding instruction and quiz is excellent continuing education. Three wishes for future improvements: the ability to bid and play from any position, and some way to ask questions and get answers about the logic behind the recommended bidding and playing approaches and someone to proofread the columns before publication to eliminate the obvious mistakes. I am available for the last one.

reviews.title: Essential Educational Bridge Application
reviews.text: Audrey Grant’s Better Bridge combines an incredible variety of useful, absolutely essential Bridge information; presented within an exceptionally functional user interface. The application presents a wide variety of topics, suggestions, tactics, and strategies. The challenge and variety of topic combined with the varied manner of presentation hold’s the user’s interest. The landscape display on the iPad Pro 12.9 is attractive and exceptionally legible. Very highly recommended, and well worth the expense!
